method.driver: Existing tools/visible-playtest.mjs via npm run playtest:visible, interactive TTY JSON commands only
method.observations: Actual JPEG captures inspected with view_image and visible UI status only. No gameplay/source/tests/other reviews read; no game edits. Navigation discovered through signage, markers and minimap.
method.graphics: Driver reported Software-WebGL fallback enabled; renderer not certified. Actual renderer backend unverified.
limits: Discrete screenshots and automatic Escape pauses substantially limit difficulty and aiming judgments.
No hardware FPS, audio enjoyment, human-fun or certification claims.
Two attempts only; no victory, extraction completion, upload decay/reentry or successful charge-break coverage.
Settings and jump not exercised; full enemy behavior variety not established.

attempts.actions: Walked central yard past induction guard; sprinted toward west signage; strafed and approached waist-high receiver; held E; used ADS and fire; reloaded; dashed and sprinted to heart; held E; aimed and fired at sentinel, earning one elimination; moved toward east and died. Read recovered memory archive after death.

Deployed again; ADS fired at induction optic and eliminated warden; reloaded and sprinted west; fired at visible enemies and earned second elimination; approached receiver and held E while firing; reloaded; dashed/sprinted to heart and recovered it; dashed/sprinted east; adjusted into floor ring after move-closer prompt and recovered third memory; followed green extraction marker, sprinted/dashed toward it; entered ring, turned toward yard; upload advanced (JPEG showed 46%); ADS fired at nearby enemy and died before completion.

findings.observation: Cohesive cyan/amber rain-soaked station presentation, strong title hierarchy, wet ground reflections and legible major area signs establish a consistent setting.

At 1280x800 the How to Play threat-visor paragraph runs beneath the Understood button; its lower lines are visibly clipped/covered. The status text supplies more than the screenshot comfortably presents.
findings.suggestion: Make handbook content scroll clearly or size the dialog so the full explanation remains above its action.

findings.observation: Objective markers, nearest-core distances, recovered-core counters and explicit move-closer/hold-E prompts enabled discovery of all three receivers without route instructions. All memories switched the objective to a green extraction marker and a six-second hold instruction.
Multiple recent-fire/source panels overlap around the lower center during return and recovery, increasing visual clutter while enemies remain small or outside the view.
findings.suggestion: Separate stacked cue panels or reduce nearby label overlap.

findings.observation: Death screen preserved recovered names, mission statistics and an accessible archive. Short character memories add concrete narrative purpose to recovery.

Precision optic fire visibly rewarded critical eliminations; sustained inaccurate fire spent ammunition quickly. Recovery restored supplies and shield in visible readouts. Two deaths occurred while exposed, but screenshot-driven input prevents attributing these to unfair balance.

whole_game.reason: Coherent playable recovery/combat/extraction loop and polished interface identity; two complete death outcomes, but no win and limited continuous combat evidence.

gameplay.reason: Recoveries, reloads, critical hits, dash cooldown, shield and final hold create several decisions; only one rifle and a compact mission observed, with charge-break depth unproven.

presentation.reason: Strong art direction, typography, rain and reflected light; repeated simple geometry and small block-like enemies limit visual richness.

usability.reason: Clear objective progression, restart and archive flows; handbook clipping and exact ring eligibility require improvement.

readability.reason: Major objectives and cyan destinations read well; small technical text, overlapping threat labels and tiny distant enemies make combat parsing denser.

AAA_readiness.reason: Promising vertical slice with coherent polish, but observed scope, geometry/enemy detail, handbook clipping and limited validation do not establish production breadth or AAA readiness.

driver_errors: Three UI selector attempts failed while closing the archive/redeploying: ambiguous RETURN, blocked deploy while dialog remained open, ambiguous data-close. Corrected using visible Close archive label. These were automation locator errors, not game faults. No page errors reported in successful commands.

closure.verification: ps -p 54774,54775 -o pid=,comm= returned empty output and exit 1, verifying both exact owned PIDs absent.

changes: Only this report and driver evidence artifacts; no gameplay edits, commits or pushes.
